explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the input as a body fragment, then walked every token with `next_token()`. For each ordinary `#text` token, I checked the decoded text from `get_modifiable_text()` with `strpos()` and wrapped the normalized token serialization from `serialize_token()` in `<mark>`; all other tokens are serialized unchanged, which preserves normalized HTML and skips special-element contents because they are not ordinary `#text` tokens.
